item.title: 📆 Top News Today Moving forward: the Vostok Group's units liberated the settlement of Vasilkovoye
item.description: 📆 Top News Today ▫️ Moving forward: the Vostok Group's units liberated the settlement of Vasilkovoye in Zaporozhye region. ❌ Paralysing enemy rear : the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched strikes with unmanned aerial vehicles against energy infrastructure facilities, which provide power for enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry and facilities of the AFU, production and storage areas of attack UAVs, as well as vessels with military materiel and dual-use cargo. 💥 Stronghold's end: the Vostok Group's assault detachments mop up AFU stronghold in Dnepropetrovsk region. 👊 Yuzhnaya Group's high skills: the Group's drones, supporting the advance of assault groups, hit the enemy in Kramatorsk direction. 🏥 Rescue line: the Tsentr Group's unique forward medical centre received the first patients. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against power infrastructure facilities, logistics centres in Ukraine, an
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against power infrastructure facilities, logistics centres in Ukraine, and vessels used to support the AFU. Today, during the day, the following targets were hit : ▪️ the Sukhoy Port logistics centre in the port of Odessa, used for storing and distributing cargo to support the AFU; ▪️ a dry cargo ship carrying weapons and military equipment in the Black Sea, 141 km southwest of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏥 Rescue line: the Tsentr Group's unique forward medical centre received the first patients.
item.description: 🏥 Rescue line: the Tsentr Group's unique forward medical centre received the first patients. An underground medical station is equipped to provide qualified assistance directly on the line of combat contact. Close proximity to the front line allows to receive patients in critical condition immediately after being wounded, to quickly stabilise them, and to send them to the next stages of hospitalisation. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
